_noteE: HIT ORDER MATTERS (Cowork 2026-07-16 triage of the Skipped golden): Kindred E is ONE instantaneous bite = BaseBiteDamage + PercentBiteDamage(%MISSING hp), both on the SAME pre-bite HP. The engine evaluates a Missing-HP hit against the RUNNING target HP, so if BaseBiteDamage lands FIRST it reduces HP and the %missing hit then reads an INFLATED missing (its own base damage double-counted) — exact repro of the golden overshoot: 0 marks 160.63 (want 159), 2 marks 166.93 (want 165). FIX: the %MISSING hit is ordered FIRST so it reads the true pre-bite missing (base is flat/HP-independent, so order doesn't affect it). Reordered engine → 155.25 / 160.47 (0/2 marks) at the golden's fixture AD 75. RESIDUAL (~4 below measured 159/165): the fixture's bonus AD (75) is ~4.5 raw short of the bite's measured AD term (~79.5 implied by 190.8 raw) OR the missing HP was >626 at capture — a MEASUREMENT-INPUT gap, not an engine bug. Claude Code: build+verify the reorder value, then either re-measure Kindred E capturing exact bonus AD + missing, or align the test fixture.
